verdict: UPS grew revenue 6.7% to $22.9B by charging more per package, but a $182M goodwill impairment and transformation costs held GAAP profit down — and management still raised its full-year outlook.

segments.name: U.S. Domestic
segments.note: Packages inside the U.S. — revenue per piece rose 6.1%, so growth came from price more than volume.

segments.name: International
segments.note: Cross-border packages — revenue per piece rose 15.0%, the pricing star of the quarter, and margins held at 14.9%.

segments.name: Supply Chain Solutions
segments.note: Forwarding, warehousing and healthcare logistics — up 18.2%, the fastest-growing piece, though a goodwill impairment cut its profit to $92M.

opex.name: Compensation & benefits
opex.note: Pay and benefits — the biggest cost by far, and down from $12,118M a year ago as the network is automated and resized.

opex.name: Purchased transportation
opex.note: Buying truck, air and rail capacity from others — up sharply from $2,463M a year ago.

opex.name: Fuel
opex.note: Fuel for trucks and planes — up from $1,071M a year ago.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Wear and tear on planes, trucks, hubs and software.

opex.name: Repairs & maintenance
opex.note: Keeping the fleet and hubs running.

opex.name: Other expenses
opex.note: Everything else it takes to run the network day to day.

opex.name: Other occupancy
opex.note: Rent and running costs of buildings and facilities.

otherDetail: Investment income and other of $116M, less $289M of interest expense, for a net cost of $173M.
oneTimers: GAAP results include a net charge of $279M, or $0.32 per share: after-tax transformation strategy costs of $130M and a $182M goodwill impairment charge in Supply Chain Solutions, partly offset by a $33M gain on selling MD-11 aircraft assets. Adjusted EPS was $1.69 vs $1.37 GAAP.
footerNote: UPS does not report a cost of revenue or gross profit — every operating expense is shown as a running cost, so gross profit equals revenue in this view. Expense lines are from the Q3 2026 Form 10-Q consolidated income statement.

takeaways.title: Growth in every segment
takeaways.text: Revenue rose to $22.9B with all three segments growing — Supply Chain Solutions led at +18.2%, and U.S. and international pricing per piece rose 6.1% and 15.0%.

takeaways.title: GAAP profit took one-off hits
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS fell to $1.37 from $1.55 as a $182M goodwill impairment and transformation costs landed in the quarter. Adjusted EPS was $1.69.

takeaways.title: Guidance raised anyway
takeaways.text: Management raised full-year 2026 guidance to about $92.6B of revenue and roughly $7.28 of adjusted EPS, heading into the holiday peak with its most automated network ever.
